climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A DO in the southeast of Albacete province, in the transition zone between the high La Mancha plateau and the Mediterranean. It is known for red wines, with Garnacha Tintorera, Monastrell, Garnacha Tinta, Tempranillo and several international reds among its allowed grapes.
